capabilities: Mark a selected passage as redacted via right-click menu or command
Toggle redaction on the selection with a hotkey
Lift the redaction bar by running the command again on the same passage
disambiguation: Redaction is visual only; the words stay in the file as plain text and are not removed or hidden.
extras: The theme renders the bar itself; the plugin only places the marker, and manual <mark class="redacted"> markup works identically. Can be installed via BRAT; no build step.
intentEvidence: Companion plugin for the Manifold theme.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visually redact passages, and doing it by hand requires typing the <mark class="redacted"> markup manually.

relations.evidence: Companion plugin for the Manifold theme.

summary: Companion plugin for the Manifold theme that marks a selected passage as redacted, rendered by the theme as a bar with words knocked out.
